title: 第十二章 五心向天
content_zh:
“嗯。”罗峰激动点头。
在神经反应测试机旁的总教官邬通笑道：“好了，下一个，白阳。”
罗峰走到杨武身边，杨武一脸惊喜之色，压低声音道：“疯子，恭喜啊，你现在可是准武者了。只要一通过武者实战考核，可就是武者了！”罗峰也低声说道：“杨哥，你这神经反应测试过关肯定没问题，到时候我们一起进行实战考核。”
“嗯。”杨武心中也期待的很。
随后罗峰和杨武的注意力集中在正在考核的人员身上。
很快，接连二人测试过，一名成功，一名失败。
“最后一个，杨武！”总教官邬通喊道。
杨武深吸一口气，他为了这一天等待了太久太久，而且他一直都是被拦在速度测试那一关，现如今总算有资格在极限会馆这里进行神经反应测试。
“加油。”罗峰鼓励喊道。
“放心。”
杨武大步直接进入了那红圈范围内，随着总教官邬通按动开始按钮，顿时那神经反应测试机的炮口开始旋转起来，很快达到极快旋转速度，炮口内数十个枪口瞬间射出一个个橡胶子弹，将红圈给覆盖。
只见杨武迅速地移动，在前后左右一步范围内移动，非常的简洁。
“嗯？”罗峰观看着杨哥的躲避身法，暗自惊讶，“杨哥的身法，似乎略显僵硬。没有我那般灵活迅疾，可是杨哥这种身法效率似乎很高，每一次躲避幅度都不大，他根本没有利用红圈直径三米六的范围，只是在前后左右一步范围内移动。”
杨武移动范围小，可是躲避效率却很高。
“这种身法，实战的时候的确很有用处。不过，却要对战斗控制的非常精细。否则出现一点误差，怪兽的利爪就可能撕裂掉武者的身体！”罗峰暗自评价，至少这种身法在罗峰看来，效率是高，可是危险性也很大。
等于是刀锋上跳舞。
“呜～～”很快一分钟过去，神经反应测试机的炮口停止旋转。
“60秒，被击中52次，未碰触红光，合格。过关！”总教官邬通开口道。
红圈内的杨武激动的双拳紧握，手臂上都满是青筋，双眸中都隐隐现出泪花，为了这一天，他等待了太久太久。终于，他实现了梦想，离传说中的武者称号，也只剩下最后一步。
“杨武。”总教官邬通皱眉喝道，“你这种躲避攻击的身法，是属于‘入微’级躲避身法。在和怪兽生死厮杀中，通过小幅度的身体移动，让怪兽的攻击擦着身体而过，伤不到自己！因为身体移动幅度小，自然同样的时间内，可以作出更多次数闪避，效率极高。”

“可是这种身法难度极高极高，一旦有一丝误差，原本你计算中怪兽的利爪是和你身体相差两公分，伤不到你。可出现误差……怪兽的利爪，就可能划过你的身体。将你开膛破肚！在和怪兽厮杀中，一旦犯错，很可能就会丧命。所以――”
“我奉劝你，以后和怪兽战斗的时候，躲避的时候，尽量躲避的更远一点。让自己有转圜余地。”总教官邬通郑重道，“你如今的实力，最好还是将基础身法训练好。效果反而更好。”
杨武一惊，而后郑重点点头：“是，总教官。”
“杨武，你要谨记总教官这番话，武道途中，切忌贪功冒进。入微级别身法，是很强大。可是如果没实力施展这等身法，而强行施展，只会东施效颦，白白让人笑话。”教官江年认真嘱托道。
总教官邬通一笑道：“好了，这次准武者考核，一共过关三人，分别是罗峰、白阳、杨武。”
罗峰、杨武、白阳三人双眸中都有着压制住的喜悦。
如果不是周围有一群武者前辈，恐怕他们早就兴奋的大叫起来了。
“各位，接下来的事情，还有签订实战考核合约等，你们帮忙做一下。”说着，总教官邬通看向一直站在边缘中的一名银发黑袍男子，笑道，“队长，让你等这么久，抱歉，走，我们出去吧。”
罗峰等三人大吃一惊，总教官那可是整个扬州城内极限武馆这一方的总头头，地位极高。他喊‘队长’，那这个银发黑袍男子又是什么身份？
银发黑袍男子目光扫了一眼罗峰三人，一时间罗峰只感觉这银发黑袍男子的双眸就仿佛那无垠的星空，整个人瞬间就沉陷在其中了，可是紧接着罗峰一个激灵，整个人就清醒过来。“到底怎么回事？”罗峰忽然发现，旁边的杨武、白阳二人表情变得呆滞。
“好可怕，一个眼神就让我们完全呆滞掉。”罗峰心中震惊。
这实力，太可怕了。
比如二人对战，还没有交手，对方一个眼神就让自己意识模糊，恐怕等自己清醒过来，已经被对方一刀刺穿心脏了。
银发黑袍男子微微一笑，惊讶看了一眼罗峰。
“小家伙，天赋不错，好好努力。”银发黑袍男子对罗峰微笑道。
“咦，意志力也不错，啧啧。”总教官邬通也满意点点头。
随即，总教官邬通和银发黑袍男子直接离开了这。
“怎么了，刚才怎么回事？”
“我怎么了？”
杨武和白阳二人，这才清醒过来，二人相视一眼这才回忆起之前的事，不由吓得一身冷汗。不管是杨武、白阳，还是罗峰……在他们成长到如今，刚才那个银发黑袍男子的确是最可怕的人物。

“这银发黑袍男子，一直在旁边看着我们测试。可是，从开始到刚才，我根本没注意到他的存在。”罗峰心中暗惊，“不出声，就仿佛空间中没这个人一样。太不可思议了。不对……”
罗峰努力回忆银发黑袍男子长相的时候，却震惊发现――
自己只记得那一双让人沉陷进去的眼睛，根本记不起来那人长得样子。
“你们三个过来。”
教官江年等一群武者们笑着看着三人，“来练武厅。”
从神经反应测试房间，进入了宽敞的练武厅中。
“这是三份武者实战考核申请合约。”其中一个肥胖老者从练武厅角落取出三份合同，“武者实战考核，一旦参加，若在过程中被怪兽击杀。是和我极限武馆无关的！当然，武者实战考核死亡率是很低的。”
罗峰、杨武、白阳三人都接过这合约，翻看着内容。
“死亡率低，可是伤残率却不低。”一名光头壮汉低沉道，“武者实战考核，是和怪兽生死搏杀！当然这是最基础的搏杀，等你们将来真的独自去危险区域猎杀怪兽，危险可比这武者实战考核可怕的多。如果连这关都过不了，是没有当武者的资格的。”
罗峰、杨武、白阳三人彼此相视。
合约很简单，主要是说实战考核中出现死亡伤残，极限武馆概不负责。
三人没有犹豫，直接取来旁边的签字笔签下自己的名字。
“嗯。”
旁边教官江年微笑道，“好，今天7月1号，距离实战考核还有一个月。在这一个月当中你们要好好准备。对了。”说着教官江年走到旁边的键盘前，迅速的按动一些按键，很快练武厅的墙壁上浮现了透明巨大屏幕，屏幕上出现了一篇文章。
名为――《基因原能修炼法》。
“嗯？”罗峰不由屏息。
武者们身体之所以强大，甚至于有一些顶级武者的移动速度，甚至于做到超过音速！一刀可以劈开几米厚的钢板！当然现如今罗峰他们的实力，和传说中的强者相比，差距很大。
武者为什么强大？
靠的就是基因原能！
“当年，大涅盘时期。人类感染rr病毒，产生抗体。导致身体基因自然而然进行改变优化。”教官江年微笑道，“当基因优化到一定程度，就能够吸收宇宙间的丝丝能量，融入全身每一个细胞！这过程中，基因优化，骨骼、细胞、血液、内脏、皮肤等等都会发生不断得进化提高！”

“你们的骨骼可以变得比金刚石还硬十倍百倍，你们内脏强大的可以一口气在水中憋气半个小时，乃至更久！”
“这一切，都要靠你们吸收宇宙间的能量，融入每一个细胞中，成为你们自己的能量。也就是――基因原能！”
教官江年指向屏幕上的文章：“这，就是基因原能的修炼方法――五心向天修炼法！也是整个地球上，唯一一种修炼基因原能的方法。”
罗峰立即仔细
基因原能，人类优化基因，进化的依仗！
“原来是这样。”罗峰仔细一看就明白了。
普通人是无法修炼的，因为基因优化程度还不够。一般达到拳力900公斤，速度25米每秒，神经反应速度在准武者合格线上。达到这程度时，基因优化程度差不多就达到合格线了。百分之九十的准武者，都能开始修炼基因原能！
“你们这一个月，可以开始尝试修炼基因原能。”教官江年微笑道，“至于最珍贵的‘导引术’，却是等你们成为武者，加入我极限武馆或者军队等等，才能获得的。”
修炼基因原能方法，全世界只有一种。
可是导引术，全世界有千万种。修炼不同的导引术，可以令修炼基因原能的速度相差极大。甚至于相差数十倍。导引术才是各势力最珍贵的。
――――――
今天星期一，将推荐票投给番茄吧！。
content_en:
"Yeah." Luo Feng nodded excitedly.
Chief instructor Wu Tong, who was standing next to the neural response testing machine, smiled and said, "Okay, next, Bai Yang."
Luo Feng walked to Yang Wu. Yang Wu had a look of surprise on his face and lowered his voice: "Madman, congratulations, you are now a quasi-warrior. As soon as you pass the warrior's actual combat assessment, you will be a warrior!" Luo Feng also whispered: "Brother Yang, you will definitely have no problem passing the neurological reaction test. Then we will conduct the actual combat assessment together."
"Yeah." Yang Wu was also looking forward to it.
Luo Feng and Yang Wu then focused their attention on the personnel being assessed.
Soon, two people tested it one after another, one succeeded and the other failed.
"The last one, Yang Wu!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong shouted.
Yang Wu took a deep breath. He had been waiting for this day for too long, and he had always been blocked in the speed test. Now he was finally qualified to take the nerve reaction test at the Extreme Club.
"Come on." Luo Feng shouted encouragingly.
"Don't worry."
Yang Wu strode directly into the red circle. As the chief instructor Wu Tong pressed the start button, the muzzle of the neural response testing machine suddenly began to rotate, and soon reached an extremely fast rotation speed. Dozens of muzzles in the muzzle instantly fired rubber bullets one after another, covering the red circle.
I saw Yang Wu moving quickly, moving within one step forward, backward, left, and right, very concisely.
"Huh?" Luo Feng watched Brother Yang's evasive movement and was secretly surprised, "Brother Yang's movement seems a little stiff. He is not as flexible and quick as me, but Brother Yang's movement seems to be very efficient, and the range of each dodge is not large. He did not use the three-meter-six-meter-diameter diameter of the red circle at all, and only moved within one step forward, backward, left, and right."
Yang Wu's movement range is small, but his evasion efficiency is very high.
"This kind of movement is indeed very useful in actual combat. However, the battle must be controlled very finely. Otherwise, if there is a slight error, the monster's claws may tear the warrior's body apart!" Luo Feng secretly commented that at least in Luo Feng's opinion, this type of movement is highly efficient, but it is also very dangerous.
It's like dancing on the edge of a knife.
"Woo~~" A minute passed quickly, and the muzzle of the neural response testing machine stopped rotating.
"60 seconds, hit 52 times, no red light, passed. Passed!" Chief Instructor Wu Tong said.
Yang Wu in the red circle clenched his fists excitedly, his arms were full of veins, and there were tears in his eyes. He had been waiting for this day for too long. Finally, he realized his dream and was only one step away from the legendary warrior title.
"Yang Wu." Chief Instructor Wu Tong frowned and yelled, "The movement skills you use to dodge attacks are at the 'subtle' level. In a life-and-death fight with a monster, you can use small body movements to allow the monster's attacks to pass you by without hurting you! Because the body movements are small, you can naturally dodge more times in the same period of time, which is extremely efficient."
"But this kind of movement is extremely difficult. If there is a slight error, your original calculation of the monster's claws is two centimeters away from your body and cannot hurt you. But if there is an error... the monster's claws may scratch your body and disembowel you! When fighting monsters, if you make a mistake, you will probably die. So -"
"I advise you, when fighting monsters in the future, when you dodge, try to hide as far away as possible. Give yourself room for maneuver." Chief Instructor Wu Tong said solemnly, "With your current strength, it is best to train the basic body skills well. The effect will be better."
Yang Wu was startled, and then nodded solemnly: "Yes, Chief Instructor."
"Yang Wu, you must keep in mind the words of the chief instructor. On the way to martial arts, you must not be greedy for merit. The movement techniques at the micro level are very powerful. But if you don't have the strength to perform such movements and use them forcefully, you will only imitate them.It's nothing but a joke. "Instructor Jiang Nian asked seriously.
Chief Instructor Wu Tong smiled and said: "Okay, this time the quasi-martial artist assessment, a total of three people passed the test, namely Luo Feng, Bai Yang, and Yang Wu. "
Luo Feng, Yang Wu, and Bai Yang all had suppressed joy in their eyes.
If there weren't a group of senior warriors around, I'm afraid they would have screamed excitedly.
"Everyone, please help with the next steps, including signing the actual combat assessment contract, etc. "As he said that, Chief Instructor Wu Tong looked at a man with silver hair and black robes who had been standing on the edge, and said with a smile, "Captain, I'm sorry for keeping you waiting for so long. Let's go out. "
Luo Feng and the other three were shocked. The chief instructor was the head of the Extreme Martial Arts School in Yangzhou City, and his status was extremely high. He called "Captain", so what is the identity of this man with silver hair and black robe?
The silver-haired and black-robed man glanced at Luo Feng and the others. For a moment, Luo Feng felt that the silver-haired and black-robed man's eyes were like the boundless starry sky, and he was instantly immersed in them. But then Luo Feng suddenly woke up. "What's going on? "Luo Feng suddenly noticed that the expressions of Yang Wu and Bai Yang next to him became dull.
"It's so scary, one look can make us completely stunned. "Luo Feng was shocked.
This strength is so terrifying.
For example, when two people are fighting against each other, before they even fight, the other party's look will make him confused. I'm afraid that when he wakes up, he will have been pierced through the heart by the other party's knife.
The silver-haired man in black robe smiled slightly and glanced at Luo Feng in surprise.
"Little guy, you have good talent, please work hard. "The man with silver hair and black robe smiled at Luo Feng.
“Hey, your willpower is pretty good too, tsk tsk. "Chief instructor Wu Tong also nodded with satisfaction.
Immediately, Chief Instructor Wu Tong and the silver-haired man in black robe left the place directly.
"What's wrong, what happened just now? "
"What's wrong with me? "
Yang Wu and Bai Yang finally came to their senses. They looked at each other and then recalled what happened before. They couldn't help but break out in a cold sweat. Whether it was Yang Wu, Bai Yang, or Luo Feng... as they grew up to this point, the silver-haired and black-robed man just now was indeed the most terrifying figure.
"This man with silver hair and black robes has been watching us test. However, from the beginning to just now, I didn't notice his existence at all. Luo Feng was secretly shocked, "If you don't make a sound, it's as if there is no such person in the space." It's incredible. That’s not right…”
When Luo Feng tried to recall the appearance of the silver-haired and black-robed man, he was shocked to discover -
I only remember those eyes that made people sink into them, but I can't remember what that person looked like at all.
“You three come here. "
Instructor Jiang Nian and a group of martial artists looked at the three of them with a smile, "Come to the martial arts training hall. "
From the nerve reaction test room, we entered the spacious martial arts training hall.
“These are three application contracts for warriors’ actual combat assessment. "One of the fat old men took out three contracts from the corner of the martial arts training hall, "A warrior's actual combat assessment. Once you participate, if you are killed by a monster during the process. It has nothing to do with my extreme martial arts gym! Of course, the mortality rate of warriors in actual combat assessments is very low. "
Luo Feng, Yang Wu, and Bai Yang all took the contract and looked at the contents.
“The mortality rate is low, but the disability rate is not. "A bald man said in a low voice, "A warrior's actual combat assessment involves a life-and-death fight with a monster! Of course, this is the most basic fighting. When you actually go to dangerous areas to hunt monsters alone in the future, the dangers will be much more terrifying than this warrior's actual combat assessment. If you can't even pass this level, you are not qualified to be a warrior. "
Luo Feng, Yang Wu, and Bai Yang looked at each other.
The contract is very simple. It mainly states that the Extreme Martial Arts School will not be responsible for death or disability during the actual combat assessment.
The three of them did not hesitate and took the pen next to them to sign their names.
"Hmm. "
Jiang Nian, the instructor next to him, smiled and said, "Okay, today is July 1st.There is still one month left before the actual combat assessment. You must prepare well during this month. Right. "As he spoke, instructor Jiang Nian walked to the keyboard next to him and quickly pressed some keys. Soon a huge transparent screen appeared on the wall of the martial arts training hall, and an article appeared on the screen.
It's called - "Gene Energy Cultivation Method".
"Huh? "Luo Feng couldn't help but hold his breath.
The warriors' bodies are so powerful that some top warriors can even move faster than the speed of sound! One knife can split a steel plate several meters thick! Of course, the current strength of Luo Feng and the others is far behind compared to the legendary strong men.
Why are warriors so powerful?
It depends on the original energy of genes!
“That year was the period of Nirvana. Humans are infected with rr virus and produce antibodies. Causes the body's genes to naturally change and optimize. "Instructor Jiang Nian smiled and said, "When the gene is optimized to a certain level, it can absorb the energy of the universe and integrate it into every cell in the body! During this process, genes are optimized, and bones, cells, blood, internal organs, skin, etc. will continue to evolve and improve! "
“Your bones can become ten and a hundred times harder than diamond, and your internal organs are so powerful that you can hold your breath in water for half an hour or even longer! "
“All of this depends on you absorbing the energy of the universe, integrating it into every cell, and becoming your own energy. That is - genetic energy! "
Instructor Jiang Nian pointed to the article on the screen: "This is the cultivation method of genetic energy - the Five Hearts to Heaven cultivation method! It is also the only way to cultivate the original power of genes on the entire earth. "
Luo Feng immediately carefully
Genetic energy, human optimized genes, the basis of evolution!
“So that’s it. "Luo Feng understood after taking a closer look.
Ordinary people cannot practice because their genes are not optimized enough. Generally, the fist strength reaches 900 kilograms, the speed is 25 meters per second, and the nerve reaction speed is on the line of qualifying for a quasi-martial artist. When this level is reached, the degree of genetic optimization has almost reached the qualifying line. Ninety percent of quasi-warriors can start cultivating genetic energy!
"This month, you can start trying to cultivate your genetic energy. "Instructor Jiang Nian smiled and said, "As for the most precious 'guidance technique', you can only obtain it after you become a warrior and join my extreme martial arts gym or the army. "
There is only one method in the world for cultivating genetic energy.
But there are thousands of kinds of guidance techniques in the world. Practicing different guidance techniques can make the speed of cultivating genetic energy vary greatly. Even the difference is dozens of times. Guidance is the most precious thing among all forces.
――――――
